address: Kılıçalipaşa Mahallesi, Meclis-i Mebusan Sokak No:14/2E, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34433, Türkiye
bio: ROKA boasts stunning Bosphorus views, thanks to its location on the Galataport promenade. Inside, the atmosphere is trendy and vibrant. Kick off with a stylish cocktail or an expertly selected wine, then prepare to experience a cuisine that marries Japanese seasonings with influences from around the globe. Fans of Asian cuisine can choose from an abundant menu of dishes that are perfect for sharing, including an extensive sushi selection, king crab dumplings, succulent chicken and yuzu miso-marinated cod from the robatayaki grill.
